crossRefs.note: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth.
Friends deceive each other, and will not speak the truth. They have taught their tongue to speak lies. They weary…
For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter…
His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.
For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised…
His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,
For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters…
No one sues in righteousness, and no one pleads in truth. They trust in vanity, and speak lies. They conceive mischief…
There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes…
“Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
“Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”
So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all…

translations.web: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
translations.bsb: You unleash your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit.
translations.kjv: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.
translations.asv: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, And thy tongue frameth deceit.
